probes.check: am_probe_jolt_handles(): body ids with each index and sequence bit set, the largest id and the invalid id convert to am::handles::JoltBody and back unchanged.

seeded_violation.description: Store body ids in 16 bits, since a level has few bodies.

adaptation_notes: am::handles::JoltBody carries a JPH::BodyID's whole 32-bit value; from_jolt and to_jolt convert between them.

The PhysicsSystem owns every body. A BodyID's sequence number tells a removed body's id from a reused index, so glue keeps the whole id, never only the index, and never keeps a Body* past the lock that returned it.
